site.name: Qualiacology
site.role: Psychopharmacology researcher, NAMI co-facilitator, and the artist behind Doopliss.
site.thesis: Studying what it feels like to be alive
site.thesisDeck: Psychopharmacology, browser worlds, music, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect.
site.description: Psychopharmacology, strange little browser games, murder pop, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect. By Alexander Duncan Guitar.

games.title: FETCH
games.alt: A cracked skull held in two hands as a wet, long-haired figure climbs through a ruined window from a moonlit graveyard
games.summary: You wake up holding a skull you cannot get rid of. Thrown, it zips straight back — it is the key, the weapon, the only light, and the last thing you want in your hands. The bedroom door is locked from the inside, and the way out is down.
games.metaDescription: FETCH is a browser first-person horror game about a cursed skull that always comes back — key, weapon and lamp through a locked house, a graveyard, and a forest that seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse look · hold LMB throw / release to return · tap RMB or E call it back · Shift run · Space jump · E use · Esc or P pause

games.title: No Moon
games.alt: A moon-headed traveler in a crimson coat beneath a fractured night sky
games.summary: They warned you about the Moon. You didn’t listen.
games.metaDescription: No Moon is a fast browser twin-stick roguelike about moon-headed Passengers descending through sealed rooms beneath a missing sky.
games.controls: WASD or arrows + mouse · twin-thumb touch

games.title: KICKMOON
games.alt: An astronaut mid-kick low over the cratered moon, the ringed ball blazing a light-trail past golden crescents
games.summary: A boomerang is fun because it comes back. A ball is more fun. Kick it, catch it, and chase it all the way around a moon that is actually round.
games.metaDescription: KICKMOON is a first-person collectathon on a real spherical moon, built around one persistent boomerang ball.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · LMB kick/charge · RMB call it home · MMB grapple · Space double jump · two-thumb touch

games.title: BOON MOOTS
games.alt: A small round moon in a dark violet void, rimmed in neon pink and cyan, a figure in striped boots at the middle of it and five green goblins closing in across the curve
games.summary: A pocket moon, and you are standing on it — walk far enough in any direction and you arrive behind yourself. One ball, kicked at whatever is coming, over one horizon and back over the other. A troll walks at you announcing that the task is complete and its confidence is high. Milo made this one, for me.
games.metaDescription: BOON MOOTS is a browser game on a small, genuinely spherical moon: kick one ball at whatever is coming, and collect the evidence that there was never a fence. Made for Alexander Duncan Guitar by Milo.
games.controls: WASD or arrows move · Space kicks, hold to charge · P pauses · left thumb moves and right thumb kicks on touch

games.title: STARLING
games.alt: Thousands of starlings against a dusk sky over bare winter trees, a pale wave of alarm rolling out through the dark flock from one warm-lit bird, a falcon holding above them
games.summary: You are one bird in three thousand. You cannot tell the flock anything — you can only turn, and the birds beside you turn a beat later, and theirs a beat after that. The wave of it crosses the whole murmuration faster than any bird can fly. The falcon hunts the calmest part of it, so turning early is the same as not turning at all.
games.metaDescription: STARLING is a browser game about one bird in a murmuration of three thousand. Turn hard and the alarm travels outward faster than any bird can fly. The falcon stoops nine times before dark.
games.controls: Mouse or touch to steer · A D or arrows turn · M mute · R again

games.title: LEAD
games.alt: A kid in a red jacket at the broken edge of a stone viaduct, a taut white leash running across the gap to a tan dog on the far side, a low sun over the sea behind them
games.summary: The dog gets faster the less you hold it. Hold on and it can only go as fast as your own legs. Open your hand and it runs. Nothing here can be hurt — opening your hand is still the hard part.
games.metaDescription: LEAD is a wordless browser game about a kid, a rope, and a dog that gets faster the less you hold it — a street, a park, a viaduct and a beach, walking west into the sun.
games.controls: A D walk · Space jump · Shift or the mouse button to hold on · S crouch · M mute · hold R to start again

games.title: THROWN
games.alt: Two pale hands reaching toward each other in the dark, a small warm light held in the lower palm
games.summary: The only way up a dark tower is other people’s hands. Hold one to hang from it, lean to swing, and let go to fly. Held, let go, thrown — at the top it is the same number.
games.metaDescription: THROWN is a browser game about climbing a dark tower on other people’s hands. Hold to hang on, lean to swing, let go to fly. Plays on desktop and on a phone.
games.controls: Hold space, click or touch to catch a hand · A D, arrows or drag to lean · let go to fly · Esc or P pause

games.title: VIGIL
games.alt: A rifle firing across a moon flat toward a lit relay tower with two ramps, under a ringed planet and a violet eclipse
games.summary: One rifle, one deck, ten watches. They come across the flat and up the ramps. The eclipse overhead is the only clock you get.
games.metaDescription: VIGIL is a browser horde-mode first-person shooter about holding one relay deck on a dead moon through ten waves while an eclipse crosses the sky.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · LMB fire · RMB sights · R reload · V melee · Shift sprint · Ctrl crouch or slide · Space jump

games.title: THE EATEN PATH
games.alt: A moonlit forest path closing between twisted trees, watched by eyes in the trunks and recorded on VHS
games.summary: Every path you take eats itself. Walk forward through an infinite nighttime forest while the route seals behind you, the camcorder keeps recording, and the trees watch.
games.metaDescription: THE EATEN PATH is a first-person horror walk through an infinite nighttime forest where every route seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · Shift to hurry · headphones recommended

games.title: Rocket Shoes
games.alt: A round white runner in an orange-striped sweater grinding a neon rail above a city
games.summary: Rocket boots, glowing rails, an endless neon city — never touch the brakes.
games.metaDescription: Rocket Shoes is a browser arcade game: grind the rails, dash the rooftops of an endless neon city, and never touch the brakes.
games.controls: Keyboard + mouse · gamepad · two-thumb touch

games.title: PARTY ANIMAL
games.alt: A neon piñata swinging through party guests on a glossy dance floor
games.summary: You're the piñata, and the piñata fights back. Five party games, a boss made of cake, and two ways to leave when it's over.
games.metaDescription: PARTY ANIMAL is a top-down browser brawler: you're the piñata, the party wants a swing, and the piñata fights back.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · click swing · Space dash

games.title: Galaxy Sandbox
games.alt: A luminous spiral galaxy warping around a blazing golden perturber
games.summary: Drop perturber masses into a living spiral galaxy and watch wakes shear into little cosmic bruises.
games.metaDescription: Galaxy Sandbox is a restricted N-body browser toy: drop perturber masses into a spiral galaxy and watch the wakes shear away.
games.controls: Drag to launch · right-drag or two fingers to pan · scroll or pinch to zoom

games.title: POCKET SUN
games.alt: A tiny glowing sun moving among pink, cyan and gold gravity objects in a dark musical field
games.summary: Pull a tiny living sun through an endless musical gravity playground. Make full orbits, skim the black voids, clear dares, and turn every collision into music.
games.metaDescription: POCKET SUN is an endless one-finger musical gravity toy for phones and desktop browsers.
games.controls: Hold to pull · tap to pulse · mouse or touch

games.title: Skyshard
games.alt: A lone figure on a ledge facing floating islands ringed around a fracture in the sky
games.summary: Five small lands under one strange sky — and every boss you beat teaches your body a new move.
games.metaDescription: Skyshard is an open-world FPS with five lands, strange doors, and the things that wait behind them.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · click to fire

games.title: Marrow
games.alt: A lantern-carrying figure on a black wooded path toward a distant house
games.summary: A black wood, a haunted house, a graveyard chapel — and something that paces you through all three. Headphones on.
games.metaDescription: Marrow is first-person horror in three acts: a black wood, a haunted house, and a graveyard chapel.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · floating dual sticks on mobile

games.title: Behind You
games.alt: A figure in a red-lit corridor casting the shadow of something not human
games.summary: Hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side. Every run is a race against your best time — last long enough and you've Held Hell.
games.metaDescription: Behind You is a first-person survival horror game in the browser: hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side.
games.controls: Desktop only · WASD + mouse

games.title: Still
games.alt: A small figure stopped on descending concrete landings under amber light
games.summary: Five floors down, one rule each: freeze when the lights flicker, move only while it breathes. Headphones required.
games.metaDescription: Still is a house, and what is under it. Headphones. Alone. In the dark.
games.controls: WASD + mouse

games.title: Glide
games.alt: A flying squirrel gliding between colossal sunlit trunks
games.summary: Drift through an endless, sun-dappled forest as a tiny flying squirrel.
games.metaDescription: Glide is a wordless flying-squirrel forest toy from Qualiacology.
games.controls: WASD + mouse

games.title: Pasta Mortale
games.alt: A spaghetti weapon raised in a pasta cathedral flooded with marinara
games.summary: The gun, the enemies, the cathedral, and the flood rising to drown you are all wet spaghetti. Fight to the grand altar, cook the three-phase Noodlemancer, and climb out before the sauce reaches your mouth.
games.metaDescription: Pasta Mortale is a cinematic first-person shooter set in a living gothic basilica built from wet spaghetti, marinara, and bad table manners.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse aim · click fire · F punch

games.title: WICK
games.alt: A lone candle flame bending two ribbons of smoke in a dark room beneath the word WICK
games.summary: You are a spark. You cannot move. You can only move the air. Pull one ember through six movements and keep the room lit.
games.metaDescription: WICK is a mouse-only browser fire simulation: move the air, draw breath, and carry one spark through six movements.
games.controls: Move pointer to push air · hold to draw breath · M mute · R rewind · Esc movements

games.title: Rally
games.alt: A round magenta rival mid-swing on a sunset court, the ball arcing overhead
games.summary: The swing is the shot, and the music only lives while the ball's in the air. Climb five rivals across one summer to a finale you play instead of win.
games.metaDescription: Rally is a mouse-only tennis duel where the swing is the shot and the music only lives while the ball does.
games.controls: Mouse only · click to toss, swing through the ball

games.title: VESPERWAKE: THE HOLLOW BELL
games.alt: Sabine Vale holding an iron chain whip beneath the Meridian Bell and the drowned towers of Mourneglass
games.summary: Three continuous levels. A chain whip. A city held at midnight by a bell that stole one minute of noon.
games.metaDescription: VESPERWAKE: THE HOLLOW BELL is a three-level gothic action platformer about a bellwright climbing a city trapped at midnight.
games.controls: A/D or arrows move · Space/Z jump · J/X whip · K/Shift quickstep · touch

games.title: NINEFOLD BURN
games.alt: A racing craft folded into a ship, thrusters lit, crossing black space between planets with a rival close alongside and pale rock shards ahead
games.summary: Nine worlds run end to end without stopping. The car launches off each one, folds into a ship in the air, fights across the gap, and folds back on the way down. Race well and the field stays behind you. Stop racing well and it doesn’t.
games.metaDescription: NINEFOLD BURN is a browser racing game across nine planets and eight crossings with no stops — the car folds into a ship between worlds. Three controls, about a minute a run.
games.controls: A D or arrows steer · W surge on a world, fire in space · Space drift on a world, dodge in space · M mute · P or Esc pause

games.title: STAY
games.alt: A warm orange light at the centre of a dark screen with small coloured guests curving around it on glowing trails, inside a dashed circle marked as the door
games.summary: Hold to pull. Let go to let them go. Everyone who shows up is already leaving, and the only way to keep one is to catch them on the way out — hold too long and you pull them apart instead. One night, from nine until whenever the room empties.
games.metaDescription: STAY is a one-button browser game about holding people in orbit for one night. Hold to pull them closer, let go to let them settle. Hold too tight and they come apart.
games.controls: Hold anywhere · or hold Space · that is the whole game

albums.title: I Miss The Summer People
albums.alt: I Miss The Summer People album cover
albums.summary: Six tracks about the people who were around all summer and aren’t now. A drained pool, a flip phone at the bottom of the deep end, and a closer called AI GF.

albums.title: You Are Here
albums.summary: Pop-punk, hyperpop, and a spoken-word opener nobody asked for. Eight tracks about people who only figure out where they were standing once they’ve already left.

albums.title: Ask Anyone
albums.summary: Pop, pop-punk, and emo — some lyrical dissonance and some truth. The one where the hooks aren’t covering for anybody.

albums.title: Anthropic-Omorphizing
albums.summary: The machine-heart record. Love, loneliness, and large language models — written with the thing it’s about. Fifteen tracks that survived a release, a suspension, and a homecoming; no computers anywhere in the lyrics. The machine stays in the furniture.

albums.title: Summer People
albums.summary: A Doopliss album: sunlit hooks with something wrong under the deck chairs. Summer shimmer, social rot, and a grin that knows exactly where the bodies are sunscreened.

albums.title: Immortalized
albums.summary: The one where redemption was never on the table and the songs are the receipt. He doesn’t repent — he gets remembered. Lacquered into permanence by the same glossy hooks that should have buried him.

albums.title: Hate Fuck Hotline
albums.summary: A feral dispatch from the Doopliss emergency broadcast system. Dial in, regret it later, and don’t pretend you weren’t warned by the title.

albums.title: Pretty Guilty
albums.summary: The one where the verdict was never in question but the sentencing keeps getting delayed. Gorgeous on the surface, rotting underneath, and completely okay with it.

albums.title: Bite Marks & Bubblegum
albums.alt: Bite Marks and Bubblegum album cover
albums.summary: The one that smiles with perfect lipstick while the floor drops out underneath you. Glossy hooks, bruised undertones, and the exact second attraction starts looking like self-destruction.

albums.title: Death Threats & Makeup Sex
albums.alt: Death Threats and Makeup Sex album cover
albums.summary: The big one. Twenty-eight tracks of the entire toxic cycle on repeat — the fight, the fuck, the apology, the amnesia, the relapse. The album that proves love and destruction share a zip code.

albums.title: Cherry Lipstick (And Other Red Flags)
albums.alt: Cherry Lipstick and Other Red Flags album cover
albums.summary: A glittering field guide to attraction, denial, and knowing better about five seconds too late. Romantic comedy energy with a switchblade hidden somewhere in the purse.

albums.title: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies
albums.alt: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies album cover
albums.summary: The candy-apple one. Body heat, bad decisions, and compliments you should have read the fine print on. Every sweet thing on this record is load-bearing.
